---
title: "LightLogR Course Certificate"
format:
  typst:
    page-size: a4
    flipped: true
    colorlinks: false
params:
  participant_name: "Dr. Alex Example"
  completion_date: "2025-10-07"
  level: "beginner"
  use_case: "Therapy lamps"
  use_case_focus: "Merging protocol logs with wearable data and reporting illuminance dose summaries"
---

```{=typst}
// Page + palette
#set page(
  paper: "a4",
  flipped: true,
  margin: 1.5cm,
  fill: luma(98%),
)
#let primary = rgb("2a3950")
#let accent = rgb("2b9cb5")
#let border = stroke(
  paint: primary,
  thickness: 3pt,
  dash: "densely-dashed",
)

// Decorative frame and ribbon
#place(rect(width: 100%, height: 100%, stroke: border, radius: 18pt))
#place(
  align: center + top,
  polygon(
    points: ((0pt,0pt),(60pt,34pt),(120pt,0pt)),
    fill: gradient.linear(
      colors: (accent, rgb("72c6d9")),
      direction: (0pt,48pt),
    ),
  )
)
#place(
  align: right + top,
  box(
    fill: primary,
    inset: 12pt,
    radius: 8pt,
    text(fill: white, weight: "bold", size: 12pt, "Open & Reproducible"),
  )
)

// Header row with banner + logotype
#stack(
  dir: ltr,
  spacing: 12pt,
  image("assets/LLR_Tutorial_Banner.png", width: 50%),
  box(
    width: 45%,
    fill: white,
    radius: 10pt,
    stroke: stroke(paint: accent, thickness: 1.5pt),
    inset: 14pt,
    column[
      text(size: 10pt, fill: primary, weight: "medium", "Open and reproducible analysis of light exposure and visual experience data"),
      text(size: 20pt, fill: primary, weight: "bold", "Certificate of Completion"),
      text(size: 11pt, fill: accent, weight: "regular", "Awarded by the LightLogR course team"),
    ],
  ),
)

#v(18pt)

// Recipient block
#box(
  width: 100%,
  fill: white,
  radius: 12pt,
  stroke: stroke(paint: primary, thickness: 1.5pt),
  inset: 18pt,
  column[
    text(size: 12pt, fill: primary, weight: "medium", "This is to certify that"),
    text(size: 30pt, weight: "bold", fill: primary, tracking: 0.5pt, "{{< param participant_name >}}"),
    v(6pt),
    text(size: 12pt, fill: primary, "successfully completed the LightLogR webinar series"),
    text(size: 12pt, fill: primary, "on {{< param completion_date >}}."),
    v(10pt),
    grid(
      columns: (1fr, 1fr),
      gutter: 12pt,
      box(
        fill: rgb("f0fbff"),
        radius: 8pt,
        inset: 12pt,
        column[
          text(size: 11pt, fill: primary, weight: "medium", "Course track"),
          text(size: 14pt, weight: "bold", fill: accent, capitalize("{{< param level >}}")),
          text(size: 10pt, fill: primary, "Beginner covers the full LightLogR workflow; Advanced focuses on applied use cases."),
        ],
      ),
      box(
        fill: rgb("f5f7ff"),
        radius: 8pt,
        inset: 12pt,
        column[
          text(size: 11pt, fill: primary, weight: "medium", "Use case focus"),
          text(size: 14pt, weight: "bold", fill: accent, "{{< param use_case >}}"),
          text(size: 10pt, fill: primary, "{{< param use_case_focus >}}"),
        ],
      ),
    ),
  ],
)

#v(16pt)

// Learning outcomes
#box(
  width: 100%,
  fill: white,
  radius: 12pt,
  stroke: stroke(paint: accent, thickness: 1.25pt),
  inset: 16pt,
  column[
    text(size: 13pt, weight: "bold", fill: primary, "Learning outcomes"),
    v(6pt),
    list(
      marker: "•",
      spacing: 8pt,
      text(size: 11pt, fill: primary, "Walk through the LightLogR workflow: import → (pre-)processing → visualisation → metrics."),
      text(size: 11pt, fill: primary, "Sense-check data quickly with tidy, reproducible steps and overview plots."),
      text(size: 11pt, fill: primary, "Handle common issues (gaps, irregular sampling, zero inflation) with principled defaults."),
      text(size: 11pt, fill: primary, "Add photoperiod information and derive interpretable summaries."),
    ),
  ],
)

#v(14pt)

// Signatures row
#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 1fr, 1fr),
  gutter: 16pt,
  box(
    fill: white,
    radius: 8pt,
    inset: 10pt,
    column[
      text(size: 11pt, fill: primary, weight: "medium", "Course leads"),
      text(size: 12pt, weight: "bold", fill: primary, "Johannes Zauner"),
      text(size: 10pt, fill: primary, "Technical University of Munich & Max Planck Institute for Biological Cybernetics"),
    ],
  ),
  box(
    fill: white,
    radius: 8pt,
    inset: 10pt,
    column[
      text(size: 11pt, fill: primary, weight: "medium", "Course leads"),
      text(size: 12pt, weight: "bold", fill: primary, "Manuel Spitschan"),
      text(size: 10pt, fill: primary, "Technical University of Munich & Max Planck Institute for Biological Cybernetics"),
    ],
  ),
  box(
    fill: rgb("f0fbff"),
    radius: 8pt,
    inset: 10pt,
    column[
      text(size: 11pt, fill: primary, weight: "medium", "Verification"),
      text(size: 12pt, weight: "bold", fill: accent, "LightLogR Webinar Series"),
      text(size: 10pt, fill: primary, "https://tscnlab.github.io/LightLogR_webinar"),
    ],
  ),
)
```

::: {.callout-note title="Preview" collapse="true"}
To test-drive the certificate with the defaults above, run:

```bash
quarto render _certificate.qmd --to typst-pdf
```

Replace `params` to personalise the PDF:

```bash
quarto render _certificate.qmd --to typst-pdf \
  -P participant_name="Ada Lovelace" \
  -P completion_date="2025-10-07" \
  -P level="advanced" \
  -P use_case="A Day in Daylight" \
  -P use_case_focus="Analysis across devices, time zones, and participant metadata"
```
:::
